articles.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

articles.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
articles.snippet: The firm previously estimated it handled 4% of global crypto exchange trading volume and raised $17 million after the FTX collapse.

articles.title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
articles.snippet: AWS Mining and NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddie Petion were ordered to pay $1.37 billion after defrauding hundreds of thousands of people, including 11,000 New Yorkers.

articles.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

articles.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
articles.snippet: Zakura is pushing to stop new payments into Sapling sooner, citing the possibility that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken the math protecting it.
